title: Represent legacy missing server identity in wait-delta TypeScript types
outcome: Optional review5 hardening: current producer schema requires serverInstanceId on the four wait record delta types, but the transport deliberately accepts missing identity from older backends and repairs through state snapshots. Consider serverInstanceId?: string with explicit narrowing before local watermark/reducer use, or a distinct legacy wire-input type. No runtime defect found; missing/empty identity integration tests already cover behavior. Keep current/retired/unproven admission semantics.
